reader.requirement: At --std 85 a level-01 data description entry admits IS EXTERNAL (Working-Storage only) and IS GLOBAL (File or Working-Storage Section) with their X-23/X-24 meanings, and every other clause keeps its Nucleus rules. EXTERNAL is refused off level 01, outside Working-Storage, beside REDEFINES, with VALUE and on FILLER; GLOBAL is refused off level 01, in Linkage and on FILLER.

edition-consulted.switches: refuses GLOBAL in the Linkage Section at 85 (construct linkage-global-2002)
the VALUE clause on an EXTERNAL item is a 2002 construct, refused at 85 with COBOL0900

reader.edition-search: ClausePlacementRules (level, section, REDEFINES, FILLER) and CallBindExternalAndGlobal hold no edition test. The edition differences on this path are the three construct gates listed above.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 85, GLOBAL in Linkage, VALUE on EXTERNAL and EXTERNAL AS are refused; 2002+ admits them. Level-01 placement, sharing and visibility do not differ.

reader.notes: This is a pointer rule. The level-01 entry admits both clauses at 85 with their meanings, and every placement restriction probed is refused. The COBOL2404 messages quote §2023 text at --std 85.

refuter.evidence: Probes at --std 85. r3a_ext_dup (two 01 XA EXTERNAL): COBOL2159, refused per §1985:X.4.5.3 SR2 (cite.py OK). r3b_global_dup (01 GA GLOBAL in the File Section and in Working-Storage): COBOL6862, refused per §1985:X.4.6.3 SR2 (cite.py OK). r3c_ext_value_sub (VALUE on an item subordinate to EXTERNAL): COBOL0900, refused per X.4.5.3 SR3. r3c2_ext_cond_value (an 88 VALUE under EXTERNAL, which SR3 allows): EXIT 0, prints ON. r3d_global_redefines (01 REDB REDEFINES BASEA GLOBAL; the contained program names BASEA): COBOL1639, refused because only the REDEFINES subject is global, per §1985:X.4.6.4 GR3 (cite.py OK). r3d2 (the contained program uses REDB): EXIT 0, 'INNER ABCD / OUTER WXYZ'. r3e (a local G1 hides the global G1 in INNER, and DEEP sees the global): 'INNER G1=INNER / DEEP G1=OUTER / OUTER G1=OUTER', which is correct. cite.py: OK  §1985:X.4.3.4 GR1  (4.3.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR1.
